layout.arrangement: Framed schematic slide: white background; thin red border rectangle inset ~2% from edges; thin blue border rectangle inset ~5% containing all content. One large composite diagram fills the middle (~8-88% x, ~8-80% y): five stacked rounded-rectangle 'heads' offset diagonally from front-left (h=1, red, largest, fully detailed) to back-right (h=5, pink), each badged h=1..h=5 in black ovals at its top-right corner. A translucent yellow-green parallelogram beam rises from the front head's top edge to a cluster of Y output boxes at top-center-right. A thick red curved arrow labeled '*h* Heads' (blue italic) sweeps along the right side. Five vertical W_q/W_k/W_v triplets form a diagonal band along the heads' lower-right. Bottom-center: dashed input row X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄ (X₂ red, dashed-circled) overlapped by five translucent colored ellipses. Title line centered at the bottom inside the blue frame; yellow '11' badge at top-right; solid black strip across the very bottom (video-player artifact).

recreation_brief:
1. Slide 16:9, white background. Draw a red (#DD0000, ~1.5pt) unfilled rectangle inset ~2% from every edge; inside it a blue (#2222CC, ~1.5pt) unfilled rectangle inset ~5%. All content goes inside the blue frame.
2. Top-right (~93% x, ~9% y): yellow (#FFE135) circle ~0.45in diameter, thin dark outline, bold black '11' centered.
3. Heads: draw five rounded rectangles ~5.6in x 2.6in, stacked back-to-front, each ~0.55in right / ~0.28in up from the previous: h=5 pink #F5B8B8 (back), h=4 green #8FE0A0, h=3 yellow #EDE87E, h=2 lavender #B9AEE3, h=1 red #F28B8B (front, leftmost; spans ~10-67% x, ~31-78% y).
4. Black oval badge (~0.55in x 0.28in, bold white text) at each head's top-right corner: h=1, h=2, h=3, h=4, h=5.
5. On each head's top edge: white oval 'Similarity' (left) and white oval 'Weighted SUM' (right), small dark text; add a 'Probabilities' oval only on h=1 (above the Softmax box).
6. Inside h=1 (left to right): (a) 4 dashed green-border (#22AA44) boxes X₁-X₄ stacked vertically; (b) white boxes with red text W_v^0-W_v^3; (c) tiny boxes K₁-K₄; (d) tall tan #D8C8A0 rectangle labeled 'Dot Product' with ~8 blue #2244CC dots joined by thin lines inside, plus small box 'K·q' at its top-right; (e) tall pink #D890C8 rectangle with vertical dark-red text 'Scaling by √d', and a small box above showing the fraction K·q/√d; (f) tall pink rectangle with vertical text 'Soft max'; (g) white box with large blue 'Σ'; (h) four red ⊗ nodes in a descending diagonal below-right of Σ, thin red lines joining them to Σ and red arrows from the Softmax area into each; (i) tiny boxes V₁-V₄, then white boxes W_v^0-W_v^3 (red text), then a second dashed green column X₁-X₄; connect stages with thin arrows.
7. On heads h=2-h=5 add simplified copies (dashed X columns, small red/green/blue W boxes, Similarity/Weighted SUM ovals), each partially hidden behind the head in front.
8. Diagonal band at the heads' lower-right, from (~62% x, ~65-77% y) to (~80% x, ~50-62% y): five vertical triplets W_q^{<h>} (red #CC3333), W_k^{<h>} (green #33AA33), W_v^{<h>} (blue #3366CC), white bold text, h=1..5.
9. Beam: translucent (~50% transparency) yellow-green #D8E830 parallelogram from h=1's top edge (~40% x, ~31% y) up to (~72% x, ~10% y); at its top place 4 dashed green-border boxes with green text Y₁-Y₄, and just below them a row of 4 pale-yellow #F0E060 boxes.
10. Thick red #DD0000 curved arrow (~4pt) from (~60% x, ~66% y) beside h=1's right edge sweeping up-right to (~83% x, ~43% y) beside h=5; blue #2244CC italic text '*h* Heads' along its upper part.
11. Bottom-center (~19-41% x, ~71-76% y): long dashed-border rounded box containing X₁, X₂ (red text), X₃, X₄; black dashed ellipse around X₂; thin connector with small green arrow up to h=1's X column.
12. Over the input row: five overlapping ~50%-transparent ellipses, largest to smallest: #7B9FE8, #9B7FE0, #B08FE8, #E8D87B, #8FD98F.
13. Small white box labeled 'W_v' just above the input row; optionally a white pencil icon angled 45° at ~34% x, ~65% y (presenter's cursor — omit for a clean slide).
14. Title centered at ~89% y inside the blue frame, bold Times New Roman ~28pt: 'Multi Head ' in #CC0000, 'Self Attention of Word ' in black, 'X' in #CC0000 with red subscript '2'.
